limitations: descriptive estimates only; Holm inference not run
no pseudo-level or time-shifted control in this first pass
OHLCV price geometry only; MBO mechanism not evaluated
no execution, fills, costs, stops, P&L, or trading authority
protected_swing_survival requires a separate preregistered survival/censoring protocol and is not computed by this diagnostic
origin-zone/Order Block reaction requires a separate first-retest reaction and matched-zone control protocol and is not computed by this diagnostic

primary_outcome.invalidation: one contemporaneous M1 ATR opposite semantic direction
primary_outcome.name: target_before_invalidation
primary_outcome.target: one contemporaneous M1 ATR in semantic direction

secondary_outcomes.continuation_distance_atr: maximum favorable completed-bar close displacement from the known_at close across the full same-contract horizon, divided by known_at ATR
secondary_outcomes.mae_atr: maximum adverse intrabar excursion from the known_at close across the full same-contract completed-bar horizon, divided by known_at ATR
secondary_outcomes.mfe_atr: maximum favorable intrabar excursion from the known_at close across the full same-contract completed-bar horizon, divided by known_at ATR
secondary_outcomes.mfe_over_mae: mfe_atr divided by mae_atr when mae_atr is positive
secondary_outcomes.next_qualified_bos_direction: direction of the first strictly later same-instrument qualified BOS
secondary_outcomes.next_qualified_bos_direction_match: whether the next qualified BOS direction equals the assigned signal direction
secondary_outcomes.next_structural_direction_match: whether the next structural event direction equals the assigned signal direction
secondary_outcomes.next_structural_event_direction: direction of the first strictly later same-instrument raw boundary break, qualified BOS, or MSS Core
secondary_outcomes.next_structural_event_id: identity of the first strictly later same-instrument raw boundary break, qualified BOS, or MSS Core
secondary_outcomes.next_structural_event_kind: kind of the first strictly later same-instrument raw boundary break, qualified BOS, or MSS Core
secondary_outcomes.next_structural_event_known_at: known_at of the first strictly later same-instrument structural event
secondary_outcomes.next_structural_event_time: event_time of the first strictly later same-instrument structural event
secondary_outcomes.range_extension_atr: maximum directional extension beyond the known_at bar extreme across the full same-contract horizon, divided by known_at ATR
secondary_outcomes.retracement_depth_atr: maximum completed-bar close pullback from the running directionally favorable close watermark, divided by known_at ATR
secondary_outcomes.signal_half_life_completed_bars: cohort median of the first target-or-invalidation completed-bar offset over resolved non-ambiguous samples
secondary_outcomes.time_to_first_retest_completed_bars: first later completed real 1m bar overlapping the event zone; null when no event zone exists or no retest occurs
secondary_outcomes.time_to_fvg_midpoint_touch_completed_bar: first later completed real 1m bar touching the frozen FVG-zone midpoint; null for non-FVG events, missing zones, or no touch
secondary_outcomes.time_to_invalidation_completed_bars: first later completed real 1m bar touching the frozen ATR invalidation
secondary_outcomes.time_to_target_completed_bars: first later completed real 1m bar touching the frozen ATR target
